column1: # Stage S6 P3 — the elevation model, the relief, the satellite container reader and the water data become the terrain crates. Paths name the tree before the move.
# the elevation model without its browser loader becomes terrain_elevation
# the hillshade, contours and sea band without their GPU host become terrain_relief
# the bathymetry, water mask, inland archive and sea mesh without their browser loader become water_bodies
# the satellite container reader becomes the sources of satellite_imagery; its module root and
# test folder take their crate names in s6_p3_satellite_crate_root.tsv
# the moved code names its own items from its crate root, and its sibling terrain crates by name
